title: @inth/nuxt: Nuxt cookie banner and cookie consent management
description: Cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center for Nuxt 3 and 4, with consent policies you set by location, such as GDPR opt-in or CCPA opt-out. The server resolves each visitor's policy, so the banner is in the first HTML.
features: A Nuxt module: add `@inth/nuxt` to `modules` and the server resolves each visitor's policy
Prebuilt cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center with a theme system
Auto-imported composables for a fully custom design
Analytics, ads, and pixels follow each visitor's choice through @inth/integrations: Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, GA4, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more
IAB TCF 2.4 banner and dialog components
Static hosting with a policy bundled at build time
prerequisites: An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), or `testing()` for development and tests
usage: Register the module and set `NUXT_PUBLIC_INTH_PROJECT_URL` to your Inth backend URL
Add `ConsentRoot` and a link that opens the preference dialog to `app.vue`
For the full setup, see the [Nuxt quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/nuxt/quickstart)
